subject: RM_Fexxil
departures: entire plant is translucent cobalt-blue glass, with no wood, bark or green tissue anywhere
no leaves, flowers or berries: only branching glass spines
every spine ends in a tiny hooked crystal, not a plant thorn
colour runs from deep blue at the core to pale ice-blue at the tips
a bead of liquid hangs on each crystal hook, and the edges are sharp like broken bottle-glass
